title: Expression quantitative trait locus mapping in recombinant gametes using single nucleus RNA sequencing
authors: Parker MT; Amar S; Campoy JA; Krause K; Tusso S; Marek M; Huettel B; Schneeberger K
one_liner_zh: 该文利用单核RNA测序在重组配子中定位eQTL，属于基因表达遗传定位研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Phenotypic differences between individuals of a species are often caused by differences in gene expression, which are in turn caused by genetic variation. Expression quantitative trait locus (eQTL) analysis is a methodology by which we can identify such causal variants. Scaling eQTL analysis is costly due to the expense of generating mapping populations, and the collection of matched transcriptomic and genomic information. We developed a rapid eQTL analysis approach using single-cell/nucleus RNA sequencing of gametes from a small number of heterozygous individuals. Patterns of inherited polymorphisms are used to infer the recombinant genomes of thousands of individual gametes and identify how different haplotypes correlate with variation in gene expression. Applied to Arabidopsis pollen nuclei, our approach uncovers both cis - and trans -eQTLs, ultimately mapping variation in a master regulator of sperm cell development that affects the expression of hundreds of genes. This establishes snRNA-sequencing as a powerful, cost-effective method for the mapping of meiotic recombination, addressing the scalability challenges of eQTL analysis and enabling eQTL mapping in specific cell-types.
abstract_zh: 物种个体间的表型差异通常由基因表达差异引起，而这些差异又源于遗传变异。表达数量性状位点（eQTL）分析是一种能够识别此类因果变异的方法。由于构建作图群体以及收集匹配的转录组和基因组信息成本高昂，扩大eQTL分析规模面临挑战。我们开发了一种快速eQTL分析方法，利用少量杂合个体的配子进行单细胞/单核RNA测序。通过继承性多态性模式，我们推断出数千个单倍体配子的重组基因组，并识别不同单倍型如何与基因表达变异相关联。将该方法应用于拟南芥花粉核，我们发现了顺式（cis-）和反式（trans-）eQTL，最终定位了影响数百个基因表达的精子细胞发育主调控因子的变异。这确立了snRNA测序作为一种高效、成本低廉的减数分裂重组作图方法，解决了eQTL分析的可扩展性挑战，并实现了在特定细胞类型中的eQTL作图。
